content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx and timeout rates for /v1/generate (p95 and p99 latency spike) — auto-page to #incidents, severity: high.

maria (oncall): I’m on it, grabbing logs and canaries. Paging devon and sresam.

devon: saw the page. Rolling up dashboards now — p95 jump from ~220ms -> 1.8s, p99 ~5.6s. Error rate (5xx) up ~3.4% over baseline.

incident-bot: Deploy event detected: deploy-bot rolled out redwood-serving v2.14.7 at 1793456640 to canary -> primary.

maria (oncall): timeline lines up with deploy. Can we rollback the canary?

deploy-bot: Canary completed at 1793456638. Current revision: v2.14.7 (32% traffic). Runbook options: rollback canary, promote fix, or increase fallback capacity.

sresam: Quick triage — do we see any memory/GC or connection saturation in the runtime?

troy: grabbing pod metrics. CPU looks fine. IOPS spike on model cache node, KV misses increased 5x. Something is causing repeated model cache recompute, increasing tail latencies.

devon: logs show repeated "KVCacheMiss -> rebuild segment" messages across many requests, and a backlog of async rebuilds. Example log snippet:```[1793456672] WARN kv_cache: miss key=model-64-shard-3; enqueue rebuild; queue_depth=124```

maria (oncall): That aligns with timeouts. We should rollback to v2.14.6 for safety and open a ticket for cache behavior. Suggest immediate rollback to remove pressure.

sresam: Agreed, rollback canary and start a full rollback of the rollout. If rollback fails, fallback route to legacy inference pool.

deploy-bot: Rollback command suggested: `/deploy rollback redwood-serving v2.14.6 --scope=canary,primary --reason="p99 latency regression after v2.14.7"`

devon: Running the rollback now. I’ll keep the canary pinned while we validate.

maria (oncall): Notifying support to prepare customer notification drafts. Support: what’s the immediate customer impact?

support-liaison: Affected endpoints: /v1/generate and chat streaming. Customers may see timeouts (client-side 504) and elevated latency >2s for p95. Early check: ~120 active sessions returned errors in last 15m, mostly mid-size SaaS tenants. Drafting a short incident update and workaround: retry with exponential backoff and use lower max_tokens as mitigation.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at 1793456754. Progress updates will follow.

devon: Observability: open traces show repeated KV invalidation path hitting the redis cluster; redis CPU not saturated but connection churn elevated. Suspect a code path in v2.14.7 that invalidates prefixes on cold start.

maria (oncall): If rollback completes, we should let traffic stabilize 10m then run a smoke check. Also prepare to fail traffic to fallback pool if rollback doesn't reduce 5xx.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 1793456778. Current revision: v2.14.6.

troy: Metrics starting to trend back down. p95 ~280ms now, p99 ~640ms and falling. 5xx back to ~0.6% and decreasing.

devon: Running a targeted smoke test across 8 regions. Streaming reconnects look okay. No more KV rebuild panic in logs.

maria (oncall): Support, please publish update: "We detected an elevated error and latency rate after a recent deployment. We rolled back to the previous version; metrics are recovering. We're investigating root cause and will post a follow-up." Keep customers informed.

support-liaison: Update posted to status page and to impacted customers; included temporary mitigation steps. Will attach correlation IDs and affected time window.

anna (pm): Which customers were hit hardest? Any enterprise customers requiring SLA credits or priority outreach?

support-liaison: Early list: cust-a, cust-d, cust-f — mid-volume API users. No major enterprise transactional failure reported yet. We're doing targeted outreach.

sresam: For root-cause we should collect: full redis connection logs, model cache rebuild traces, and the exact commit diff between 2.14.6 and 2.14.7 for cache invalidation code. Assigning follow-up to eng-runtime and infra.

maria (oncall): Handoff plan: I need to sign off after a 30m stabilization window. Jess (oncall-next) will take over at 1793457050. Summary for handoff: incident resolved (rollback), primary mitigation executed, customer notifs posted, suspected cache invalidation regression in v2.14.7. Next steps: postmortem, revert/patch, and add canary cache stress tests.

jess (oncall-next): I’m up for the handoff. I’ll monitor the next hour and own the postmortem coordination. Anything else I should watch for?

maria (oncall): Watch p99 tail, redis connection churn, and any reoccurrence if we try to reintroduce v2.14.7 in canary. Tag me on the postmortem drafts.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 1793457049 — severity downgraded to informative. Please file a postmortem and link to this thread.

support-liaison: Final note for handoff: customer-facing summary is in the linked status update, internal RCA ticket #RWD-INF-4321 created and assigned to eng-runtime.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Good execution.

devon: follow-up action: add automated canary test that simulates KV cache churn during rollout. I’ll put a PR up today.

jess (oncall-next): Taking over — monitoring now.
